description: Certification for immutable candidates. All shipped platforms require native identity and startup; stable and prerelease require the pinned upgrade matrix. Linux-only acceptance never authorizes publication.
targets_basis: Platform matrix of .github/workflows/build.yml (prepare-platform-matrix). gnu and macOS targets build with the pyroscope feature; musl and Windows targets build with no extra features.
trusted_workflows_basis: Receipts are produced by the reviewed main workflows and fetched by exact run ID with GitHub artifact digest verification. Candidate inputs freeze the harness commit separately from product source.

lanes.harness_basis: The exact workflow commit is frozen in candidate inputs; no mutable branch is accepted as a harness identity.
lanes.applies_basis: Artifact identity and startup checks are mandatory for every release type, preview included, on every shipped target (rustfs/backlog#2662 frozen design item 5).

lanes.harness_basis: The exact workflow commit is frozen in candidate inputs; no mutable branch is accepted as a harness identity.
lanes.cases_basis: Case IDs of the pinned previous-release matrix in .github/workflows/e2e-upgrade.yml (source.version/asset/sha256 and the case list mapped there).
lanes.applies_basis: preview releases use the pre-declared smaller set (identity lane only). The upgrade lane is only exercised on linux-x86_64-gnu, the platform of the pinned source assets.

upgrade_sources.basis: Exactly the two previous-release sources pinned in .github/workflows/e2e-upgrade.yml are exercised today (source.version / source.asset / source.sha256). No other N-1/N-2 compatibility is claimed, and these digests are not inferred from tags.
upgrade_sources.rollback_basis: Only the bucket-config-rollback case (rollback_to_previous_release_reads_current_bucket_metadata) is exercised. Full data-plane rollback is not certified and is never a default claim.
